component.name: TwinTray
component.summary: Twingate status and connection in the system tray

description.p: TwinTray is a system tray front-end for the Twingate client on Linux. It shows the current tunnel state at a glance, starts and stops the Twingate service without a password prompt, and lists the resources the client is authorized for.
Because Twingate and Tailscale both claim 100.96.12.0/12, TwinTray can stand Tailscale down while Twingate is up and bring it back afterwards.
